music: Instrumental dark cinematic true-crime documentary score, 1970s noir mood. Slow tense build: low analog synth drones, sparse muted piano notes, ticking clock pulse, deep cello ostinato, subtle rain texture. Rises in tension at the middle, a heavy low brass hit and wind-like swell for a mid-air jump, then quiet eerie ending with a single unresolved piano note. No vocals, no melody that competes with narration, 3 minutes.
